[LNUL.6.3] **Wire / hash.** `null` gets a pinned DSC encoding — the
`DS_SLOT_NULL` slot-value kind and the `nullable` **`Slot`** flag ([RDSC.7.1]) — and a pinned 64-bit hash value ([LNUL.8.8],
cf. the pinned series element-hash). In a recorded fact body a `null` is an
absent `optional` field, distinct from the type's zero ([RFCS.6.3]), so
cross-engine replay is bit-identical.
